_comment: EXAMPLE · Kafka source (@stream_publisher) — payload FORMATS, ROLLOVER axes and the dead-letter topic. data_format and schema are BOTH always required ("json" + a JSON Schema, "avro" + an Avro schema, Protobuf(message_name=...) + the .proto source) and the schema is ENFORCED, not documentation. Three independent rollover axes in src_cfg decide when a batch closes, whichever fires first: messages_rollover (count — read_json), time_rollover_seconds (latency — read_timed), size_rollover_mb (file size — read_avro); flush_interval_mins rolls a partial batch over so nothing sticks. dlq_topic (read_dlq) keeps one bad message from stopping ingestion — put it under the domain prefix so it dies with the domain. Five stream publishers over a redpanda domain seeded with the employees model, whose data plane produces one JSON message per row to <prefix>.<entity>. read_timed needs its OWN collection because it reads the same topic as read_json and a second consumer in the same group on a single-partition topic would sit idle; publishers on different topics share a group happily. The avro/protobuf topics have no producer here on purpose — an unknown topic is not fatal, the poll loop waits — so the configuration is documented without an encoder in the harness. Topics are ${D0__DB} references, not literals, so two instances can run at once. NO TRIGGERS AND NONE NEEDED: registering a stream publisher STARTS it. One function per file under functions/kafka_src/. Run: `tdx-xp oneshot --suite examples/kafka_src --keep`.
